Sounds: MusyngKite (FluidR3-based) and, for violin, viola, cello and double bass, VSCO 2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (CC0, https://github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE).
Grand piano: Salamander Grand Piano V3 by Alexander Holm (Yamaha C5), CC-BY 3.0, https://freepats.zenvoid.org/Piano/acoustic-grand-piano.html
